description: ROUGE: A database of disaster impacts in the Global South using Red Cross reports and Large Language Models is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Laura Hasbini et al. High quality data on natural hazard damages can inform disaster risk management. Yet, existing impact datasets remain limited and often biased toward Northern countries and monetary losses. Coverage: global; published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The paper's page was read, but no repository address could be taken from its machine-readable metadata, so the record links to the article, whose Data Records section names where the data sit. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
